```{r condition_setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.retina = 2, dpi = 150, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4)

source("R/site_helpers.R")

# Counts from the team's data check (before cleaning)
condition_facts =
  tribble(
    ~condition, ~full_name, ~apr_drg, ~discharges, ~hospitals, ~hospitals_30,
    "Heart failure", "Heart failure", "194", 59668, 189, 159,
    "Respiratory infection", "Major respiratory infections", "137", 35044, 190, 156,
    "Kidney/UTI", "Kidney and urinary tract infections", "463", 30248, 188, 148,
    "Stroke", "Ischemic stroke", "045", 26529, 182, 126,
    "Sepsis", "Sepsis", "720", 131139, 187, 164
  ) |>
  filter(condition == this_condition) |>
  mutate(across(c(discharges, hospitals, hospitals_30), as.integer))
```
